Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
Crusade Columbia, SC will be held this Halloween, Oct. 31
at Heroes and Dragons. Sign-up is at 10:00 and the games
should start around 10:15.

In addition, our normal 3rd-Saturday games will be held there
on the 17th, starting around noon.

Heroes and Dragons is located in the Boozer Center,
at the corner of Bush River Road and Broad River Road.

From Atlanta and Augusta, take I-20 East to I-26 East.
From Spartanburg, take I-20 West to I-26 East.
From Charlotte, take I-77 South to 277 to I-20 West to I-26 East.

On I-26 East, take the next exit (Bush River Road) and turn
left onto Bush River Road. Drive past the Dutch Square Center.
Turn left into Boozer Center just before Western Auto (across
from Wendy's).
